intro: Crown of the Earth is an Alliance quest given by Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar. He directs you to draw water from the moonwell near the Pools of Arlithrien, an area increasingly threatened by crazed Gnarlpine furbolgs. Completing this task uncovers how Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm rallied the night elves to raise Teldrassil in the wake of Malfurion Stormrage's disappearance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is another moonwell southeast of the entrance to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. The Sentinels are having problems patrolling the area because of attacks and the growing ill-temperedness of the Gnarlpine furbolgs.
Be wary as you seek out the well, and keep your weapons close at hand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Shan'do Stormrage never returned, and the druids were in disarray, and to this day we still do not know what became of him. With Malfurion missing, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm took over the leadership of the druids, convincing the Circle of Ancients in Darkshore that it was time for our people to rebuild, and that it was time for our people to regain their immortality.
With the approval of the Circle, Staghelm and the most powerful druids grew Teldrassil, the new World Tree.
